items.text: Kimarae anyamet ŋinakitete
Kedaun edeke ŋolo abu toar ŋituŋa, kirwor Ekapolon neni a Moses ka neni ka Eleasar a esacaradoti a ŋolo arae lokoku ka Aron,
“Kimara Ŋisirael daadaŋ ŋulu erae ŋikaru kec ŋatomoniarei ka adepar. Kimara ikes a ŋatekerin kec, kimara Ŋisirael daadaŋ ŋulu epedorito alosit lojie.”
Apotu Moses ka Eleasar esacaradoti kirworo ka ŋituŋa anadipoe a Moab alodiyete aŋolol Yorodan aneni iteosi ka Yeriko; tolimokis Moses ka Eleasar ŋituŋa temasi,
“Kimara ŋituŋa daadaŋ ŋulu erae ŋikaru kec ŋatomoniarei ka adepar, ikwapei icikitor Ekapolon Moses.”
Ŋisirael ŋulu apote anakwap a Ijipit ikes lu:
Ŋiletok a Ruben alokoku a Isirael a ŋolo kiya ikes lu: Anok, iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋianoki, Palu, iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋipalui,
Esiron iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋierisoni; Karimi, iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋikarimi.
Arae ŋun ŋatekerin a ŋiletok a Ruben, arae ekimar a ŋulu aponi kimarunae ŋalipyo ŋatomoniomwon ka ŋauni ka ŋamiae ŋakanikaarei ka ŋatomoniuni.
Lokoku a Palu iŋes Eliab

ka ŋidwe a Eliab ikes lu: Nemuel, Dasan ka Abiram. Dasan ka Abiram ŋul ikes abu sek ekiŋaren atukot a Ŋisirael toseu ka ikes apotu kitepega Moses ka Aron, toriwo ka ata a Kora apaki ŋina aŋerioto Ekapolon.

Apotu ikes kiyuuwaar tooma nalup, tolomasi ikes daadaŋ nalup kaapei ka Kora ŋolo apotu ŋirukitos keŋ totwaka apaki ŋina anomiyarya akim ŋikilyok ŋulu arae ekimar kec ŋamiae ŋaarei ka ŋatomonikan; apotu ŋun toruworos akitoodikinet aneni a Ŋisirael.
Nai pa keponi toarae ŋiletok a Kora.
Ŋiletok a Simeon a ŋatekerin kec ikes lu: Nemuel iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋinemueli, Yamin iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋiyamini, Yakin iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋiyakini,
Sera iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋisera, Saul iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋisauli.
Arae ŋun ŋatekerin a Ŋisimeoni, ido arae ekimar a ŋulu aponi kimarunae ŋalipyo ŋatomoniarei ka ŋaarei ka ŋamiae ŋaarei
Arae lu ŋiletok a Gad a ŋatekerin kec: Sipon iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋisiponi, Agi iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋiagi, Suni iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋisuni,
Oseni iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋioseni, Eri iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋieri,
Arod iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋiarodi, Areli iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋiareli.
Arae ŋun ŋatekerin a Ŋigadi, ekimar a ŋulu aponi kimarunae arae ŋalipyo ŋatomoniomwon ka ŋamiae ŋakan.
Arae Er ka Onan ŋidwe a Yuda ŋulusapa ŋulu apotu totwaka anakwap a Kanaan.
Ŋiletok a Yuda a ŋatekerin kec ikes lu: Sela iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋisela, Peres iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋiperes, Sera iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋisera.
Ŋiletok a Peres ikes lu: Esiron iŋes papaa ateker a Ŋiesironi, Amiul iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋiamuli.
Arae ŋun ŋatekerin a ŋiletok a Yuda; arae ekimar a ŋulu aponi kimarunae a daadaŋ ŋalipyo ŋatomonikanikaarei ka ŋakanikaarei ka ŋamiae ŋakan.
Ŋiletok a Isakar a ŋatekerin kec ikes lu: Tola iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋitola, Pupa iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋipupa,
Yasub iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋiyasubi Simiron iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋisimironi.
Arae ŋun ŋatekerin a ŋiletok a Isakar; arae ekimar a ŋulu aponi kimarunae ŋalipyo ŋatomonikanikapei ka ŋaomwon ka ŋamiae ŋauni
Ŋiletok a Sebulon a ŋatekerin kec ikes lu: Sered iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋiseredi, Elon iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋieloni, Yaleel iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋiyeleeli.
Arae ŋun ŋatekerin a ŋiletok a Sebulon; arae ekimar a ŋulu aponi kimarunae ŋalipyo ŋatomonikanikapei ka ŋamiae ŋakan.
Arae Manase ka Epuraim ŋidwe a Yosepu ŋulusapa.
Ŋiletok a Manase a ŋatekerin kec ikes lu: Makir iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋimakiri arae Makir papa a Gilead; Gilead iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋigilead
Arae lu ŋiletok a Gilead: Ieser iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋieseri, Elek iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋieleki;
Asiriel iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋiasiriel, Sekem iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋisekemiti
Semida iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋisemida, Eper iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋieperi.
Amamukar Selopead lokoku ka Eper ŋidwe ŋulusapa, nai ayakar ŋidwe ŋulupesur, tosodi arae lu ŋirorwa a ŋidwe Selopead a ŋulupesur: Mala, Noa, Ogila, Milika ka Tirisa.
Arae ŋun ŋatekerin a ŋiletok a Manase, arae ekimar a ŋulu aponi kimarunae ŋalipyo ŋatomonikan ka ŋaarei ka ŋamiae ŋakanikaarei.
Ŋiletok a Epuraim a ŋatekerin kec ikes lu: Susala iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋisusala, Beker iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋibekeri, Taan iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋitaani.
Lokoku a Susela iŋes Eran, arae Eran papaa a ateker a Ŋierani.
Arae ŋun ŋatekerin a ŋiletok a Epuraim, ido arae ekimar a ŋulu aponi kimarunae ŋalipyo ŋatomoniuni ka ŋaarei ka ŋamiae ŋakan.
Ŋiletok a Benjamin a ŋatekerin kec ikes lu: Bela iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋibela, Asibel iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋiasibeli, Airam, iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋiairami,
Sepupam iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋisepupami, Upam iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋiupami,
Ŋiletok a Bela aneni ka Ared ka Naaman ikes lu: Ared iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋiaredi, Naaman iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋinaamani.
Arae ŋun ŋatekerin a ŋiletok a Benjamin, tosodi arae ekimar a ŋulu aponi kimarunae ŋalipyo ŋatomoniomwon ka ŋakan ka ŋamiae ŋakanikapei.
Ŋiletok a Dan a ŋatekerin kec ikes Ŋisuami ŋulu arae ŋiletok a Suam.
Arae ekimar a ŋulu aponi kimarunae anateker a Ŋisuami ŋalipyo ŋatomonikanikapei ka ŋaomwon ka ŋamiae ŋaomwon.
Ŋiletok ka Aser a ŋatekerin kec ikes lu: Imina iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋiimina, Isipi iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋiisipi, Beria iŋes papaa ateker a Ŋiberia.
Ŋiletok a Beria a ŋatekerin kec ikes lu: Eber iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋieberi Malikiel iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋimalikieli.
Ayakar Aser ikoku ŋinipese ŋini anyaritae Sera.
Erae ŋun ŋatekerin a ŋiletok ka Aser, arae ekimar a ŋulu aponi kimarunae ŋalipyo ŋatomonikan ka ŋauni ka ŋamiae ŋomwon.
Ŋiletok a Naputali a ŋatekerin kec ikes lu: Yeseel iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋiyaseeli, Guni iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋiguni;
Yeser iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋiyeseri, Silem iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋisilemi,
Arae ŋul ŋiletok a Naputali a ŋatekerin kec; arae ekimar a ŋulu aponi kimarunae ŋalipyo ŋatomoniomwon ka ŋakan ka ŋamiae ŋaomwon.
Arae ekimar a Ŋisirael a ŋulu arae ŋikilyok a ŋulu aponi kimarunae ŋalipyo ŋamiae ŋakanikapei ka apei ka ŋamiae ŋakanikaarei ka ŋatomoniuni.
Kirwor Ekapolon neni a Moses tema,
“Ŋituŋa ŋul ikes ekorakinio akwap toruwor ŋina kec, iwuapitae ŋirorwa ŋulu imarunitae.

Ani ekabila ŋolo elalak ŋituŋa keŋ emaikina iyoŋ tokorak akwap daŋ ŋina alalan, tosodi ekabila ŋolo ekudyoko ŋituŋa, emaikina iyoŋ tokorak akwap ŋina edit; emaikina ŋikabilae daadaŋ toryamut akwap ŋina eruwor ŋina kec alokimar a ŋituŋa keŋ.
Nai, ekoryo akwap anakilamilam, iwuapitae ŋirorwa atapapaa a ŋikabilae.
Ekoryo ŋinakwap anakilamilam ekorakinio neni a ekabila a ŋolo elalak, kori ekudyoko ŋituŋa keŋ.”
Erae lo ekimar a ŋilepi a ŋatekerin kec: Gerisom iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋigerisoni, Kaot iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋikaoti, Merari iŋes papaa a ateker a Ŋimerari.
Erae nu ŋatekerin a Lepi: Ateker a Ŋilibini, ateker a Ŋieburoni, ateker a Ŋimali, ateker a Ŋimusi, ateker a Ŋikorai. Arae Kaos papa ka Amiram.
Arae ekiro a aberu ka Amiram Yokebed nakoku a Lepi ŋina auruunio alo Ijipit. Abu Yokebed touruut ka Amiram ŋidwe lu: Aron, Moses ka nakaato kec Miriam.
Abu Aron touru ŋidwe lu: Nadab Abiu ka Eleasar ta Isamar.
Nai apotu Nadab ka Abiu totwaka apaki ŋina ainakiniata ikes neni ke Ekapolon akim ŋina pa etaleuno.

Arae ekimar a ŋilepi a daadaŋ a ŋulu aponi kimarunae ŋalipyo ŋatomoniarei ka ŋauni, arae ŋul ŋisapa ŋulu arae apolou kec elap epei ka adepar. Pa emarakinitae ikes neni a Ŋisirael a ŋuluce, anerae pa apotu ikes toryamut akwap adio lopite ŋolo aryamuniata ŋikabilae a Ŋisirael ŋuluce.
Erae ŋul ŋituŋa ŋulu apotu Moses ka Eleasar esacaradoti kimara apaki ŋina emaryata anadipoe aŋuna a Moab alo Kide Yorodan aneni iteosi ka Yeriko.
Alotuŋa a ŋulu imarunitae a ŋul, mam ipei daŋ ŋini edounitoe apaki ŋina emaryata Moses ka Aron esacaradoti Ŋisirael analoŋisat a ŋina a Sinai.
Apotu ŋituŋa ŋul daadaŋ totwaka, anerae alimunit Ekapolon aŋuna kec ebe, “Etwakete ikes analoŋisat.” Mam ikes ipei daŋ ŋini ariŋa eyari mati Kaleb lokoku a Yepune ka Yosua lokoku a Nun.
